extension.description: Sync Cursor chats to your private GitHub repository. Imported chats show up after Cursor quits.
config.title: Cursor Session Sync
config.language: Interface language. auto follows Cursor, zh is Chinese, en is English.
config.remoteUrl: Private repository URL written after GitHub sign-in. Do not fill this in by hand.
config.pollSeconds: How often to check sync status, in seconds
config.reposChosen: Whether the repository checklist has been saved
config.excludeRemote: Skip these Git remotes, separated by commas
config.maxAgeDays: Ignore chats older than this many days. 0 means no limit.
config.onDiverged: What to do when both sides have new messages. ask shows a choice.
config.cursavesPath: Leave empty to use the sync program bundled with the extension
